boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Grand Valley traditions and recurring Laker gatherings, from the fight-song march to annual campus celebrations.

cards.title: GVSU Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Allendale Campus · fall celebration
cards.notes: Follow the official Homecoming schedule for the week’s campus activities, alumni events, and football-game gathering; dates and details change annually.
cards.short_summary: A university-backed reunion and Laker-spirit celebration with roots in GVSU’s first Homecoming in 1978.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU describes Homecoming as a tradition and documents its first celebration in 1978.
cards.source_title: Lakers fill the Valley Campus for Homecoming 2025
cards.access_notes: See the official Homecoming page and event calendar for each year’s schedule and participation details.

cards.title: Mark October 25 on Founders Day
cards.subtitle: Grand Valley State University · October 25
cards.notes: Use the university’s Founders Day materials to connect the annual observance to the community effort that chartered Grand Valley in 1960.
cards.short_summary: An annual observance of the date GVSU was chartered and the people who helped establish it.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that Founders Day is celebrated each year on October 25, the date the university was chartered in 1960.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; consult the official page and university events calendar before attending.

cards.title: Bring a Young Guest to Sibs & Kids Weekend
cards.subtitle: GVSU campus · annual family program
cards.notes: Register an eligible sibling, child, or young guest and attend together; the program is designed for GVSU community members sharing campus with kids.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide tradition that invites students, faculty, and staff to bring young guests to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU calls Sibs & Kids Weekend a university-wide tradition for bringing siblings or kids to campus.
cards.source_title: Sibs and Kids Weekend: Thank You!
cards.access_notes: Registration, age guidance, and schedules are set annually; the 2026 program listed a $10 registration fee per sibling or kid.

cards.title: Dress Up for Presidents' Ball
cards.subtitle: GVSU · annual student-life event
cards.notes: Check Campus Activities Board announcements for the current theme, ticketing, venue, accessibility details, and event rules before making plans.
cards.short_summary: One of Grand Valley’s longest-running traditions, first held in 1986.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU reports that Presidents' Ball is one of Grand Valley's oldest traditions and that the first ball took place in 1986.
cards.source_title: Faculty, staff recognized at masquerade-themed Presidents' Ball
cards.access_notes: Listed by the Office of Student Life as an annual event; consult CAB for current attendance and ticket details.

cards.title: Share Campus at Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Allendale Campus · annual Student Life event
cards.notes: Invite supporters for the current Family Weekend program, then use the official schedule to choose age-appropriate campus activities and any needed registration.
cards.short_summary: A recurring GVSU Student Life gathering built around family and supporter participation.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Family Weekend among its annual Student Life events, and CAB’s Traditions Team plans and facilitates it.
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations, registration, and any charges vary; confirm them on the current official event listing.

cards.title: Start the Year at Laker Kickoff
cards.subtitle: GVSU · annual Student Life event
cards.notes: Watch Student Life and CAB announcements near the start of the academic year for the current Laker Kickoff format, location, and participation details.
cards.short_summary: A recurring GVSU event that signals the start-of-year campus gathering season.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Laker Kickoff among its annual Student Life events.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location, and any entry requirements through the official Student Life calendar.

cards.title: Close the Year at ExtravaGRANDza
cards.subtitle: Allendale Campus · end-of-year week
cards.notes: Use the Campus Activities Board calendar to pick from the week’s listed activities and verify the daily locations before heading to campus.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong end-of-academic-year series organized around community activities and Laker spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 2026 listing describes ExtravaGRANDza as a weeklong series for the end of the school year.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 series ran April 20–24 on the Allendale Campus; future schedules should be verified on the official calendar.

cards.title: Find the Lakerpalooza Finale
cards.subtitle: GVSU · Campus Activities Board programming
cards.notes: Look to Campus Activities Board and Student Life announcements for the current Lakerpalooza program, including its date, activities, access needs, and location.
cards.short_summary: A named annual Student Life event paired with the end-of-year ExtravaGRANDza programming.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists “ExtravaGRANDza & Lakerpalooza” among annual Student Life events and assigns the programming to CAB activities leadership.
cards.access_notes: Event format and access may change; verify the current official listing before attending.

cards.title: Meet Student Organizations at Campus Life Night
cards.subtitle: Allendale Campus · annual Student Life event
cards.notes: Use the current Campus Life Night listing to find student organizations, ask about their activities, and confirm the event’s time and campus location.
cards.short_summary: A recurring GVSU gathering centered on connecting students with campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Campus Life Night among its annual Student Life events.
cards.access_notes: See the official Student Life calendar for the current date, location, and participating organizations.

cards.title: Hear the March to the Stadium
cards.subtitle: Cook Carillon Tower to Lubbers Stadium · football game day
cards.notes: At a home football game, watch for the Laker Marching Band’s route from the performing arts center, including its Carillon Tower fight-song stop.
cards.short_summary: A documented game-day band procession that carries “GVSU Victory” toward Lubbers Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU documents the Laker Marching Band stopping at Cook Carillon Tower to perform “GVSU Victory” before marching to Lubbers Stadium.
cards.source_title: Play with power, march with pride
cards.access_notes: This is tied to football game day; verify the current home-game and marching-band schedule before visiting.
